description: The study draws on the SGAV method, which the article says \"concentrates on learning verbal language\" and rests on two essential principles.
title: SGAV (structuro-global audiovisual) method principles underlying the audiovisual vocabulary treatment

description: The article describes an SGL model in which permanent, diverse groups of five to six students, formed transparently by subject major, sit and work together throughout the term.
title: A small-group learning (SGL) model for upper-level university science courses built on permanent diverse groups, frequent collaborative data-analysis activities, and accountability in evaluation

description: The SGM program is a PLTL-model supplement to two team-taught introductory biology courses at Swarthmore College, fully implemented in 2005–2006.
title: Study Group Meeting (SGM) program: a voluntary peer-led team-learning workshop supplementing introductory biology lectures
